mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.etxpyreqstdmng.mapper.WorkEtxpyUntpcMngMapper.selectWorkEtxpyUntpcMngList : 근무수당단가 LIST */ AA.CRTR_YR , AA.NIGHT_WORK_UNTPC_AMT /* 야간근무단가금액 */ , AA.WIK_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT /* 주간시간외단가금액 */ , AA.NIGHT_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT /* 야간시간외단가금액 */ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM AYC380 AA /* 근무수당단가관리 */ WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY 1 DESC
mapper.update:
MERGE /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.etxpyreqstdmng.mapper.WorkEtxpyUntpcMngMapper.mergeWorkEtxpyUntpcMng : 근무수당단가 저장 */ INTO AYC380 AA /* 근무수당단가관리 */ USING ( SELECT #{CRTR_YR} AS CRTR_YR , #{NIGHT_WORK_UNTPC_AMT} AS NIGHT_WORK_UNTPC_AMT , #{WIK_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT} AS WIK_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT , #{NIGHT_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT} AS NIGHT_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT , #{USER_ID} AS USER_ID , SYSDATE AS SDATE FROM DUAL ) BB ON ( AA.CRTR_YR = BB.CRTR_YR ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET NIGHT_WORK_UNTPC_AMT = BB.NIGHT_WORK_UNTPC_AMT , WIK_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT = BB.WIK_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT , NIGHT_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT = BB.NIGHT_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT , LAST_MDFR_ID = BB.USER_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT = BB.SDATE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( CRTR_YR , NIGHT_WORK_UNTPC_AMT , WIK_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT , NIGHT_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( BB.CRTR_YR , BB.NIGHT_WORK_UNTPC_AMT , BB.WIK_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT , BB.NIGHT_OVTIME_UNTPC_AMT , BB.USER_ID , BB.SDATE , BB.USER_ID , BB.SDATE )
mapper.delete: DELETE /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.etxpyreqstdmng.mapper.WorkEtxpyUntpcMngMapper.deleteWorkEtxpyUntpcMng : 근무수당단가 삭제 */ FROM AYC380 AA /* 근무수당단가관리 */ WHERE AA.CRTR_YR = #{CRTR_YR}
